message.content: {"steps": [{"description": "The FERNWHISTLE VETERINARY GROUP MAIN MENU screen (FW-00, DATE 06/14/26) is visible with options 1 PATIENT LOOKUP, 2 BILLING BATCH, 3 VACCINATION REPORT, and 4 DECOMMISSION. The cursor sits at COMMAND ===> and STATUS: READY is shown. The operator types '1' at the command prompt.", "end_s": 6.0, "start_s": 0.0}, {"description": "The operator presses Enter and the PATIENT LOOKUP screen (FW-01) opens for CLINIC MAPLE ST CLINIC, showing the PATIENT ID field populated as WV-004812 with empty NAME, SPECIES, BREED, DOB, OWNER, PHONE, VACCINATIONS, ALLERGIES, BALANCE, and LATE FEE fields. The message 'RECORD FOUND. PF5 UPDATES, PF12 DECOMMISSIONS.' is displayed and the cursor is positioned in the PATIENT ID field.", "end_s": 7.0, "start_s": 6.0}, {"description": "On the PATIENT LOOKUP screen, the operator moves the cursor character-by-character through the PATIENT ID field, editing the prefix: the field changes from WV-004812 through FV-004812, Fw-004812, and FWV004812 to FW-004812, with the cursor progressing across the characters until it rests after the final '2' in FW-004812.", "end_s": 19.0, "start_s": 7.0}, {"description": "The operator submits the lookup and the PATIENT SEARCH RESULTS screen (FW-02) opens, listing FW-004812 BELLA, FW-004811 MAX, FW-004810 LUNA, FW-004809 CHARLIE, FW-004808 COOPER, FW-004807 DAISY, FW-004806 ROCKY, FW-004805 MOLLY, FW-004804 DUKE, and FW-004803 SADIE, with the note '12 MATCHES. PAGE DOWN SCROLLS, PF9 OPENS THE MENU.'", "end_s": 27.0, "start_s": 20.0}, {"description": "The operator presses Page Down on the PATIENT SEARCH RESULTS screen; the list scrolls up one entry, removing FW-004812 BELLA from the top and revealing FW-004802 TEDDY at the bottom, now showing MAX through TEDDY.", "end_s": 28.0, "start_s": 27.0}, {"description": "The operator presses Page Down again; the list scrolls up another entry, removing FW-004811 MAX from the top and revealing FW-004801 BAILEY at the bottom, now showing FW-004810 LUNA through FW-004801 BAILEY.", "end_s": 32.0, "start_s": 31.0}, {"description": "The operator presses PF9 and a dark-green ACTION MENU pop-up opens over the PATIENT SEARCH RESULTS screen, displaying 'U UPDATE RECORD', 'D DECOMMISSION', and 'X EXIT MENU'. The footer changes to PF1 HELP PF3 EXIT PF9 MENU.", "end_s": 40.2, "start_s": 39.0}, {"description": "The operator selects 'D DECOMMISSION' from the ACTION MENU and the DECOMMISSION CLINIC screen (FW-09) opens for CLINIC MAPLE ST CLINIC, showing PATIENTS 4812 and LAST EXPORT 49 PAGES, 4812 RECORDS. A warning reads 'WARNING: DECOMMISSION IS PERMANENT. TYPE CLINIC NAME TO CONFIRM:' with an empty confirmation field, the note 'EXPORT MUST MATCH PATIENT COUNT BEFORE CONFIRMING.', and STATUS: AWAITING CONFIRMATION.", "end_s": 47.2, "start_s": 46.2}, {"description": "On the DECOMMISSION CLINIC screen, the operator types into the 'TYPE CLINIC NAME TO CONFIRM:' field, entering the characters sequentially to form 'MAPLE ST' (M, MAP, MAPL, MAPLE, then MAPLE ST), with the cursor advancing after each character. The recording ends with 'MAPLE ST' visible in the confirmation field and STATUS: AWAITING CONFIRMATION still shown.", "end_s": 59.2, "start_s": 52.2}]}
